First, let me identify all the **National Merit College-Sponsors in Florida for the 2021-22 academic year** (from the official Florida Student Financial Aid factsheet):

Now, among these sponsors, I need to find which ones are **closest to Tallahassee** AND offer an **undergraduate degree in aerospace engineering**.

### Key Findings:

**Florida A&M University (FAMU)** is also in Tallahassee and shares the engineering program with Florida State University through the **FAMU-FSU College of Engineering** (the only joint college of engineering in the nation). However, FAMU was NOT listed as a National Merit sponsor for 2021-22.

**Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University**, while famous for aerospace engineering, has its main campus in **Daytona Beach** (~220 miles from Tallahassee), not closest to Tallahassee.

### The Answer:

**Florida State University (FSU)** satisfies all three criteria:

1. ✅ **Location**: It is **located directly in Tallahassee** (making it the closest)
2. ✅ **National Merit Sponsor**: It was confirmed as a National Merit College-Sponsor for the 2021-22 academic year
3. ✅ **Aerospace Engineering Degree**: Through the **FAMU-FSU College of Engineering**, FSU students can earn a Bachelor of Science in Aerospace Engineering (the undergraduate program is part of the Department of Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering)

Therefore, **Florida State University** is the closest National Merit college sponsor to Tallahassee that offers an undergraduate degree in aerospace engineering.

2021-22  Fact Sheet

Benacquisto Scholarship Program

Florida Statutes 1009.893  State Board of Education Rule 6A-20.0281

Program Description

The Benacquisto Scholarship Program is a merit scholarship for high school graduates
who  receive recognition as a National Merit® Scholar. Eligible scholars  will receive an
award equal to the institutional  cost of attendance  for an in  -state student  minus the sum
of Bright Futures and  the National Merit  ® award. An initial application is not required.

Program Requirements

A student who is a Florida resident  seeking initial funding  must:
  Earn  a  standard  Florida  high  school  diploma  or  its  equivalency  (unless  the
student completes a home education program or earns a high school diploma from
a non-Florida high school while living with a parent who is on military or public
service assignment  away from  Florida).
  Be a 2021 National Merit  ® Scholar.
  Enroll at an eligible Florida postsecondary institution during the  2021-22 fall
academic term following high school graduation.
A student who is a non-Florida resident seeking initial funding must:
  Earn  a  high  school  diploma  comparable  to  a  standard  Florida  high  school
diploma or its equivalency (or completes a home education program).
  Be a 2021 National Merit® Scholar.
  Enroll at an eligible Florida postsecondary institution during the 2021-22 fall
academic term following high school graduation.
  Physically reside in Florida on or near the institution’s campus where enrolled.
NOTE: Non-Florida residents will no longer be accepted into the Benacquisto Scholarship
Program for the 2022-23 academic year and beyond.
A 2021 National Merit® Finalist becomes a Scholar by receiving:
(a) a National Merit® $2500 Scholarship,
(b) a Corporate-sponsored Merit Scholarship®, or
(c) a College-sponsored Merit Scholarship®.

NOTE:  “Special”  Corporate  Scholarships  and  “Presidential”  awards  do  not  qualify  a
student for the Benacquisto Scholarship.

Student Award Renewal

An application is not required to renew the award. Eligibility for renewal is determined
at the end of the second semester, third quarter or the equivalent of each academic year.
For automatic renewal, an award recipient will have:

A student who does not maintain a  minimum 3.0 GPA by the end of the spring semester
or third quarter of the academic year shall be  ineligible to continue in the program  .

Now, among these sponsors, I need to find which ones are **closest to Tallahassee** AND offer an **undergraduate degree in aerospace engineering**.

### Key Findings:

**Florida A&M University (FAMU)** is also in Tallahassee and shares the engineering program with Florida State University through the **FAMU-FSU College of Engineering** (the only joint college of engineering in the nation). However, FAMU was NOT listed as a National Merit sponsor for 2021-22.

**Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University**, while famous for aerospace engineering, has its main campus in **Daytona Beach** (~220 miles from Tallahassee), not closest to Tallahassee.

### The Answer:

**Florida State University (FSU)** satisfies all three criteria:

1. ✅ **Location**: It is **located directly in Tallahassee** (making it the closest)
2. ✅ **National Merit Sponsor**: It was confirmed as a National Merit College-Sponsor for the 2021-22 academic year
3. ✅ **Aerospace Engineering Degree**: Through the **FAMU-FSU College of Engineering**, FSU students can earn a Bachelor of Science in Aerospace Engineering (the undergraduate program is part of the Department of Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering)

Therefore, **Florida State University** is the closest National Merit college sponsor to Tallahassee that offers an undergraduate degree in aerospace engineering.
